unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the collection's quality information and fill-value conventions before aggregation. The archive is GIMMS-3G+ V1.2, not the older GIMMS v3.1g file used by the seed; both share the third-generation GIMMS AVHRR lineage, grid and twice-monthly cadence, but values must not be assumed cell-for-cell identical.
